spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Habla a Aarón tu hermano, y no entre en todo tiempo al santo, desde casa a la parójet, a faces de la kappóret que sobre el arca, y no muera, porque en la nube seré visto sobre la kappóret.

findings.issue: בֵּית is construct (Ncmsc). «desde casa a» reads as motion from a house to the curtain and drops the construct link to the following noun.
Common noun (Ncfsa), not a proper name, left as the transliteration parójet.
Common noun (Ncfsa), not a proper name, left as the transliteration kappóret.
לֹא plus qal imperfect 3ms is rendered with subjunctive muera, matching the earlier jussive rather than the imperfect.

notes: Names, 2ms address, 3ms prohibitions, and the verbless relative are licensed.
